title: Headset lost positional tracking
shortDescription: The Quest cameras cannot see enough feature points to track your position.
fullDescription:
Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest Pro use inside-out tracking via external cameras. When lighting is too low, surfaces are too reflective, or camera lenses are dirty, the headset loses spatial awareness and freezes the scene or disables movement.

This commonly occurs in dim rooms, against plain white walls, or outdoors in direct sunlight which washes out the IR sensors.

fixSteps.title: Improve lighting
fixSteps.instruction: Turn on bright, even room lights. Avoid direct sunlight on the cameras.

fixSteps.title: Clean cameras
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe all external camera lenses with a microfiber cloth.

fixSteps.title: Redraw Guardian
fixSteps.instruction: Reset view via Quick Settings and redraw your boundary.

whenToCallPro: If tracking fails in well-lit rooms after a factory reset, contact Meta Support.

faq.a: No, Quest uses inside-out tracking via built-in cameras.

title: Cannot load or set Guardian boundary
shortDescription: The Quest cannot recall or create a play-space boundary.
fullDescription: Guardian boundaries are stored per location. If the headset was moved, lighting changed, or the floor reference was lost, you will be prompted to redraw the boundary. Persistent errors indicate corrupted boundary data.

fixSteps.title: Clear Guardian history
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Guardian > Clear Guardian History, then redraw.

whenToCallPro: Rarely needed; if repeated after reset, contact Meta Support.

faq.a: Only developer mode allows disabling; not recommended for safety.

title: Thumbstick drifts without input
shortDescription: The Touch controller joystick registers movement when idle.
fullDescription: Drift is caused by wear or debris in the potentiometer under the thumbstick. Quest Touch controllers are prone to this issue with heavy use.
symptoms: Menu cursor moves on its own

fixSteps.title: Compressed air clean
fixSteps.instruction: Pull stick to one side and blow compressed air into the base, rotate and repeat.

fixSteps.title: Isopropyl flush
fixSteps.instruction: Apply a drop of 99% isopropyl alcohol and rotate the stick.

fixSteps.title: Warranty replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Meta for replacement if still under warranty.

whenToCallPro: If drift persists after cleaning, request replacement from Meta.

faq.a: Yes, within the one-year limited warranty.

title: Headset will not charge or charges slowly
shortDescription: The Quest is not recognizing the charger or charges very slowly.
fullDescription: Charging problems stem from weak chargers, damaged cables, dirty USB-C ports, or battery degradation after many cycles.

fixSteps.title: Use official 18W charger
fixSteps.instruction: Use the Meta-supplied adapter or an 18W+ USB-C PD charger.

fixSteps.title: Clean USB-C port
fixSteps.instruction: Shine a light in the port, remove lint with a wooden toothpick.

whenToCallPro: If headset does not charge with known-good cable and charger, contact Meta.

faq.a: Yes with sufficient-wattage charger, but may increase heat.

title: Headset repeatedly restarts on boot
shortDescription: The Quest restarts at the Meta logo and never reaches the home screen.
fullDescription: Boot loops usually follow a failed system update or corrupted storage. Recovery via bootloader menu can reinstall firmware.

fixSteps.title: Boot to recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Power + Volume Down until boot menu appears.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Select Factory Reset in the boot menu.

whenToCallPro: If factory reset fails, contact Meta Support for RMA.

faq.a: Yes, factory reset erases local data. Cloud saves are preserved.

title: Headset sleeps while being worn
shortDescription: The proximity sensor fails to detect the user's face.
fullDescription: A dirty or obstructed proximity sensor causes the Quest to go to sleep mid-use or never wake when put on.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor area
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the small sensor between the lenses with a microfiber cloth.

whenToCallPro: Only if cleaning and settings toggle do not resolve.

title: System update hangs or fails
shortDescription: Software update does not progress past a certain percentage.
fullDescription: Updates can stall due to weak Wi-Fi, insufficient battery, or full storage.

fixSteps.title: Charge above 50%
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in and wait until battery is above 50%.

fixSteps.title: Retry update
fixSteps.instruction: Reboot headset and trigger the update again.

whenToCallPro: If repeated failures, contact Meta Support.

faq.a: No, required updates will eventually enforce.

title: Image appears blurry or distorted
shortDescription: Sweet spot misalignment or dirty lenses cause blur.
fullDescription: Quest lenses have a narrow sweet spot. Incorrect IPD, eye relief, or condensation causes perceived blur.

fixSteps.title: Adjust IPD
fixSteps.instruction: Set correct interpupillary distance per model's physical slider or menu.

fixSteps.title: Clean lenses
fixSteps.instruction: Use microfiber cloth in circular motion from center outward.

faq.a: Yes with the included spacer, or use prescription lens inserts.

title: No sound or distorted audio
shortDescription: Built-in speakers or headphone output produces no audio.
fullDescription: Audio dropouts are often caused by Bluetooth pairing, software glitch, or a debris-clogged speaker grille.
whenToCallPro: If hardware failure suspected after factory reset.

faq.a: Quest 2 has 3.5mm jack; Quest 3 does not.

title: Black edges visible in view
shortDescription: Field of view is reduced due to headset position.
fullDescription: FOV clipping occurs when the headset is too far from the eyes. Adjust the strap tightness or eye relief spacer.

fixSteps.title: Tighten strap
fixSteps.instruction: Pull headset closer to face using top and side straps.

fixSteps.title: Remove glasses spacer
fixSteps.instruction: If not wearing glasses, remove the spacer for max FOV.

faq.a: Yes, aftermarket head straps improve fit and FOV.

title: Firmware update failed to install
shortDescription: Update downloaded but failed to apply.
fullDescription: Install failures are often caused by insufficient storage or network interruption during download.

fixSteps.title: Free storage
fixSteps.instruction: Uninstall unused apps to free at least 3GB.

fixSteps.title: Retry on stable Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Connect to 5GHz Wi-Fi and retry the update.

whenToCallPro: If failures persist, contact Meta Support.

faq.a: Only in developer mode with ADB.

title: Mic not picking up voice
shortDescription: Other players cannot hear you in social apps.
fullDescription: Microphone issues stem from app permissions, Bluetooth mic conflicts, or muted voice settings.

fixSteps.title: Select internal mic
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Devices > Mic > Always Use Headset Mic.

faq.a: Yes, use the Oculus Voice test in Settings.
